scope: GET/POST /api/dashboard/metrics: source failures, cache freshness and circuit breaker reliability

runtime.database: Isolated PGlite 0.5.8 copy of synthetic QA data; no production access
runtime.note: Locally available dependencies reused; GitHub CI installs the committed lockfile.

coverage: Each of the three Prisma failures returns HTTP 503 without a valid complete cache; no private exception detail in response
True zero/empty/SQL null and signed aggregate values retained
Successful GET/POST and denied requests carry private no-store; ADMIN/TEAM_LEADER allowed, CLIENT/TECHNICIAN and missing/invalid token rejected
Fallback uses the previous complete snapshot, preserves its timestamp and flags both source fields and breakerDegraded
Open/half-open/closed circuit paths, cooldown, failure recovery and concurrent callers
TTL boundary, backwards clock, UTC midnight, and invalidation during a pending read
Metric reads do not alter fixture visits/invoices/alerts or payment/communication counts

preparationIssues.detail: The first local browser run used port 3004. cw-auth.js deliberately points local API traffic to 3002, causing request failures in the operational dashboard. The QA runner was corrected to 3002; both existing dashboards then passed with unchanged production/test code.

Some early local invocations returned zero without a completion log. A synchronous result artifact and early-exit guard were added; final uninstrumented run produced ok=true, assertions-completed and PASS. No incomplete run is used as proof.

limits: Three metric source queries are still separate reads, not a transaction snapshot.
UTC day window and existing legacy aggregate scope/status filters are unchanged; do not interpret the total as certified revenue or profit.
Cache and breaker are per process; cross-process cache invalidation is not certified.
Admin alert caps, historical reconciliation, remaining localization, WhatsApp import, local AI, VPS/external copies and physical pilot remain pending.
Contract finalization remains deferred per user instruction.
No schema/dependency/frontend/cache-version changes, merge, deployment or real outbound communication.
